findings.issue: All seven v0.9.1 hardening claims are implemented: pre-execution candidate hashing; pre-load trusted snapshots, baseline, and seed-424242 probe; two invariance checks; same-address fresh-value tripwire; four-buffer anti-cache timing and promotion gate; primary-profile/full-key calibration matching; raw samples and runner SHA recording; and explicit shape-14 refusal.

Red-team evidence is consistent. rt01 patches baseline attention and the transcript records TAMPER DETECTED before journal construction; no rt01 row exists. rt02 is the stated address cache, failed the same-address tripwire, has timing=null, and was not promoted.

The four v0.9.1 entries reconcile. Timed entries contain 300 baseline, 300 candidate, and 40 anti-cache samples. Anti-cache ratios recompute as 1.0003238814, 1.0015106358, and 1.0024602600. Calibration yields the recorded 1.03 threshold; k000 is correctly unpromoted and k001 promoted. The journaled runner SHA matches the pre-Round-3 runner preserved in the audit transcript; the current SHA differs only because of the reporting-only leaderboard patch.
Round-3 champion selection is fixed: eligibility requires the current harness_version, the v0.9.0 promotion is marked legacy, and the v0.9.1 k001 entry alone is starred as champion.

The candidate is hashed before execution, but SourceFileLoader independently reloads it and may reuse timestamp-valid .pyc bytecode after a same-second, same-size edit. This did not affect the audited entries, but it is a provenance edge case.
findings.suggested_fix: Compile and execute the already-read, hashed source bytes directly.

findings.issue: Each anti-cache buffer retains the same values for five timed calls per round. A deliberately adaptive address-plus-value memoizer could therefore evade the median check. Such code is conspicuous in source review and falls outside the stated cooperative trust model.
findings.suggested_fix: For stronger adversarial resistance, refill a buffer before every timed candidate invocation.

findings.issue: Shape 14 is honestly excluded and refused, so it does not block the shapes 1–13 freeze. The documented same-process residual is acceptable under the cooperative, short-source-reviewed trust model, but would be unacceptable for hostile candidates.

summary: Sound to freeze for shapes 1–13. The requested hardening, evidence, journal arithmetic, and Round-3 leaderboard correction are valid; remaining issues are non-blocking under the explicitly cooperative trust model.
